title: A manager ends an unattended headless runner whose report is written and whose process stays, with one command instead of a hand-written monitor script
goal: backlog.py runner watch --pid PID --report FILE --stale SECONDS ends a process whose report file is older than the bound while the process lives and exits 0, and exits 0 without signalling when the process ends by itself

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();rep=os.path.join(d,"report.md")
pid=int(s.run(["sh","-c","echo done > "+rep+"; sleep 120 >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
time.sleep(2);p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","runner","watch","--pid",str(pid),"--report",rep,"--stale","1"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
time.sleep(1)
try:os.kill(pid,0);alive=True
except OSError:alive=False
if alive:os.kill(pid,15)
print(p.returncode,alive,p.stdout[-150:],p.stderr[-150:])
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and not alive else 1)

clauses.clause: backlog.py runner watch --pid PID --report FILE --stale SECONDS ends a process whose report file is older than the bound while the process lives and exits 0
exits 0 without signalling when the process ends by itself

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: 159 Monitor tool calls in the orchestrating sessions, each a hand-written script (96 'tail -F chain.log | grep ... & while true; do r=...report.md; if [ -f $r ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m $r) )) -gt 600 ] && pgrep -f "kb-sprint run SP-..."; then echo HUNG', 35 'L=<scratch>...'; median 567 characters of shell) and 76 ScheduleWakeup calls (median 1800 s). The hang is a known case: a runner writes its report and its process stays, the manager's notes call for a watchdog and a SIGTERM of the own pid; no tool does it (backlog.py find watchdog, headless and runner found no item). Low confidence and manager-only: the turns are in the wait story; the hang case costs hours. The command name and flags are a proposal; the planted check ends a planted sleeping process. Also wanted: a start form that launches a runner with a fixed session id and its brief on stdin and prints the pid. Lane: parked sprint-orchestration class, EP-gzr4mmkm.
